ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ( Source_Entity__c = 'Modon - Egypt'), ISPICKVAL( Modeofpayment__c , 'POS'), OR(ISBLANK(TransactionNumber__c), ISBLANK(TransactionDate__c), ISBLANK(Last4DigitString__c)) )
